summary: Reviewed all 15 experiments on 2026-11-02: all are planned with zero data (no domain, analytics, tracking or interviews yet), so no winner or loser is declared and every verdict is pending. Each entry lacks a minimum sample or stop date; proposed ones are listed. Three pairs overlap and should be merged.

experiments.hypothesis: A closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users yields at least 5 non-owner users who each send one real proposal by Fri 2026-11-13.
experiments.metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent (utm_campaign=2026-11-beta)
experiments.min_sample: 5 non-owner users with proposal_sent (from the hypothesis)
experiments.note: Supersedes E-O19-2. Needs a working app (owner-decisions line 0) and tracking (T6/G07). A miss is a recorded loser with the blocker named, not a retry.

experiments.hypothesis: Closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users can each send one real proposal before launch.
experiments.metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent before go/no-go
experiments.note: Duplicate of E-O20-1. Propose retiring it as superseded; do not count it twice.

experiments.hypothesis: The beachhead sends more than 3 proposals a month, so the Free cap of 3 leaves room for Pro.
experiments.metric: median proposals per month across interviewees (G41); later plan_limit_reached share of active free users
experiments.note: Supersedes E-O19-1. Kill rule from red team: median 3 or fewer per month means the Free cap decision is triggered. Self-reported data; label it that way. No interview notes exist yet.

experiments.hypothesis: Median beachhead freelancer sends more than 3 proposals a month.
experiments.metric: median self-reported proposals per month across G33 interviews
experiments.note: Duplicate of E-O20-2. Propose retiring it as superseded.

experiments.hypothesis: Solo freelancers rank 'client stalls between yes and deposit' as a top-3 pain.
experiments.min_sample: first 10 interviews; gate is 3 or more describe the gap as current pain (plan GN gate / G41)
experiments.note: Interview-based, so no ordering from a live page is needed. Waiting on owner interview notes.

experiments.hypothesis: Buyers understand 'proposal app for freelancers' better than 'brief-to-proposal app'.
experiments.metric: share of interviewees who correctly describe the product from the frame alone
experiments.min_sample: same 10-15 interviews as G33; owner to set the threshold before the first interview
experiments.note: The 'plus search volume' part of the metric cannot be measured (no keyword tool, no domain). Drop it or mark it pending so it does not block a verdict. Run the two frames to different interviewees, or in a fixed order, to avoid contamination.

experiments.hypothesis: Variant A (one-link flow) gets more trial signups than variant B (price options).
experiments.min_sample: not set. Needs a baseline rate that does not exist yet; set it after the first 7 days of traffic. A traffic split of two small cohorts will very likely be underpowered; if so, report directional only.
experiments.stop_date: not set. Tie to launch: 14 days after the page goes live
experiments.note: Cannot start: no domain, no tracking. Overlaps E-O11-1 (hero Pillar 1 vs Pillar 2) and E-JTBD-1. Run one landing test at a time, not three, or the visits are split too thin.

experiments.hypothesis: Pillar 1 (one link, brief to deposit) as hero drives more trial signups than Pillar 2.
experiments.note: Same variants as E-O8-1 (home-a vs home-b drafts). Propose merging into E-O8-1 and retiring this one.

experiments.hypothesis: Landing variants led by push, pull and anxiety forces will differ in trial-signup rate.
experiments.metric: trial signups per landing visit, by variant
experiments.note: Three-arm test, needs more traffic than a two-arm one. Sequence after E-O8-1 and only if traffic allows. No variant copy exists for it yet.

experiments.hypothesis: The 3-proposal free cap or the 14-day Pro trial, not price alone, drives trial signups from the pricing page.
experiments.note: Blocked: decision 4 (what Pro adds over Free) is open, so the pricing page cannot be published as drafted. As written, the hypothesis cannot separate cap from trial from price; it needs one variable per arm. Not startable.

experiments.hypothesis: If the beta and interview gates pass, launch week produces more than half of all trial starts in the 14 days after launch.
experiments.metric: share of trial_started by utm_source, launch week vs following 7 days
experiments.min_sample: not set. A share of a handful of trials is noise; state a minimum trial count before reading it
experiments.stop_date: launch date + 14 days (Dec 1 if Nov 17, Dec 22 if Dec 8)
experiments.note: Conditional on the gates. PH default is Dec 8 per plan rev 3. If the gates fail on Nov 13, record as not run, not as a loss.

experiments.hypothesis: Owner-led 90/10 community participation produces trials with zero mod removals.
experiments.metric: trial_started with utm_medium=community; mod removals or bans
experiments.note: Community rules are unverified (G04 not done). Any removal or ban is a stop signal and counts as a recorded loss. A 'zero removals' result on few posts proves little; record the number of posts alongside.

experiments.hypothesis: A 14-day trial email sequence raises activation (proposal_sent within 7 days of sign_up).
experiments.metric: activation rate across closed 7-day cohorts, before vs after the sequence is live
experiments.note: Before/after design, not a randomized test, so any lift is confounded by traffic mix and timing. Say so in the verdict. Blocked on G10/G11 and the email provider decision. Needs a before-cohort of real size.

experiments.hypothesis: Personal notes from the owner to their contacts get more trials per message than any public channel.
experiments.metric: trials per note sent and reply rate (utm_source=warm-network)
experiments.min_sample: not set. Number of notes is the owner's to state
experiments.note: Comparison needs per-channel trial counts and sends from tracking. Warm-network notes are hand-sent only; no bulk send.

experiments.hypothesis: Trials from the closed beta and first public launch convert to at least 5 paid Pro subscriptions, $95 MRR, in Dec 3 - Jan 1.
experiments.metric: subscription_started count and MRR on 2027-01-01; trial-to-paid over trials whose 14 days ended
experiments.note: Red team found only trials started by about Nov 18 can convert inside Day 30, so this window is the honest one. Depends on payments being live (open owner decision) and on G39 forecast. Report open trials as pending. Revenue currently 0, so nothing to read.

new_tasks.title: Merge overlapping experiments and set sample sizes and stop dates
new_tasks.brief: After the Fri 2026-11-13 gate review: retire E-O19-2 and E-O19-1 as superseded by E-O20-1 and E-O20-2, merge E-O11-1 into E-O8-1, and record the verdict (pass, fail or pending) for E-O20-1, E-O20-2, E-O8-2 and E-O8-3 from reports and research/interview-synthesis.md. Set min_sample and stop_date for the landing and pricing experiments once tracking gives a baseline. Declare winners only at the sample.
